name: Synara

runner.notes: Install the Synara desktop app (or bun run dev from source), authenticate at least one guest coding CLI outside Synara, open only runs/<run-id>/worktree as a project, create a task with prompt.md, run the guest agent, review diff/checks, then harness-verify. Record Synara version, guest provider/runtime, and interventions. Use isolated worktrees when testing parallel agents.

inclusion: Direct Class A local-first multi-agent ADE workspace: open-source desktop control plane for parallel coding agents, Git worktrees, browser verification, provider handoffs, and PR delivery.
pricing_model: Free and open source; no Synara model plan. Users bring existing coding-agent runtimes and provider accounts/subscriptions.
public_stack_signals: Official site: local-first command center for parallel coding agents with terminals, previews, diffs, and Git worktrees.
MIT-licensed monorepo at Emanuele-web04/synara; Bun/Turbo TypeScript workspace with desktop/CLI/web packages.
Origins note: began as a T3 Code fork and diverged substantially (README).
Desktop packaging scripts for macOS dmg, Linux AppImage, and Windows nsis.
MCP-native in both directions: agents inside Synara get coordination tools; external MCP clients can launch/follow Synara tasks.
capabilities_to_probe: parallel tasks with separate Git worktrees
provider portability across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Antigravity, Grok, Kilo, Pi, Droid
mid-task provider handoff with preserved task environment
terminals, browser verification, and diff review in one task
commit/push/PR delivery from the same task
external MCP integration to create/follow Synara tasks
local workspace state privacy (no required Synara account)
moat_hypotheses: local-first open-source multi-provider control plane without product account lock-in
task ownership model binding objective, runtime, terminal, browser, and delivery state
provider handoff as a first-class workflow
T3 Code lineage plus rapid UI polish for adoption
setup_notes: Download from trysynara.com/install or GitHub Releases; source dev uses bun install && bun run dev.
Guest CLIs must be installed and authenticated outside Synara before detection.
Early product: expect bugs and fast-moving internals per README.
Single-task correctness is mostly guest-agent quality; treat Synara as orchestration/environment.

research.positioning: A free, open-source, local-first desktop workspace and control plane for running multiple coding-agent runtimes in parallel with task ownership, worktree isolation, verification, and PR delivery—without replacing provider accounts.

runtime: desktop app (Electron packaging scripts in monorepo)
guest coding-agent CLIs and ACP sessions
Bun/Node monorepo toolchains for development builds
frontend: task/thread UI with split parallel sessions
backend: local application server/state on the machine
direct provider runtime connections (no Synara model proxy for normal traffic)
optional local server / remote self-hosted access (product docs)
MCP server for external task create/follow
packaging: desktop installers (macOS dmg, Linux AppImage, Windows nsis via monorepo scripts)
data: projects, tasks, provider sessions, and history stored locally by the desktop app
git worktrees and branches per parallel task
opt-in anonymous analytics disabled by default (site claim)
unknowns: Production binary release cadence and platform support matrix should be re-checked on Releases before scoring.
Exact ACP/session protocol depth per provider varies and needs hands-on detection notes.

infrastructure: Runs as a local desktop workspace layer; no Synara-hosted workspace account is required.
Provider sessions receive prompts/files/tool results needed for that provider; traffic goes to the selected provider, not a Synara model service (official privacy claim).
Parallel tasks can use isolated Git worktrees and visible ownership.
Remote access is described as explicit/self-hosted rather than a mandatory cloud account.

orchestration: one task owns objective, provider session, cwd, terminal, browser, diff, delivery state
MCP-native coordination tools for agents and external MCP clients
workspace_isolation: separate Git worktrees for concurrent agents
per-task working directory and branch ownership
review_shipping: built-in browser verification and console evidence
checks, commit, push, create PR from the same task
remote_mobile: self-hosted remote access capability (docs/REMOTE); not a first-party mobile companion ADE in reviewed marketing
context_memory: context passed forward on provider handoff
project-level resume of tasks and provider sessions

install_surface: desktop download from trysynara.com or GitHub Releases
bun install && bun run dev from source
at least one authenticated guest coding CLI
parity_risks: Early-stage product; stability and provider detection may change quickly.
Provider handoff semantics differ by runtime tools/session model.
Ensure harness worktree is the task cwd; avoid nested worktrees escaping verify root.

hypotheses: Free MIT local-first packaging undercuts paid cockpit subscriptions for multi-provider users.
Task-centric ownership plus handoffs is a clearer control plane than pure terminal multiplexers.
Open source enables fork/extension velocity similar to T3 Code/Orca class peers.
evidence: Official site and README assert free, open-source, local-first multi-provider workspace.
package.json and LICENSE confirm Bun monorepo and MIT licensing.
Site documents worktrees, browser verification, handoffs, and PR delivery.
unknowns: Sustained maintenance/bus factor beyond the primary maintainer is not established.
Head-to-head orchestration quality vs Orca/T3 Code/Conductor is unscored here.

research_status: Cataloged 2026-08-10 from official site, GitHub README, package.json, LICENSE, install and privacy pages.
